theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_sl_co_density_gradient_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (d P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P) (F : Euclid d → ℝ) (Y : Set (Euclid d)) (y : Euclid d), LipschitzWith L f → y ∈ Y → DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ y → DifferentiableAt ℝ F y → (∀ z ∈ Y, f (ψ z) = F z) → Tendsto (fun r => volume (Y ∩ closedBall y r) / volume (closedBall y r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) → ∀ e : Euclid d, |fderiv ℝ F y e| ≤ L * ‖fderiv ℝ ψ y e‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
